name: getSelfEmployeeTrainings
description: Retrieves the open course schedules available on the logged-in employee's Apply for Training page: course name, description, schedule (date/time/venue/resource person), application cut-off date, participation confirmation cut-off date, seat availability, attachment presence, objective/relevance/benefit narrative fields, and course subjects/qualifications/related needs/closure steps/sponsors. Supports narrowing by courseName (substring match) and/or scheduleId.
